title: Microsoft Purview: role-based access control for Exact Data Match upload authorisation
summary: The administrator opt-in default is not documented: the roadmap describes a choice but does not state how the new control behaves on arrival. The current security-group path and Graph operation are supported; the licensing notes should also acknowledge the published EDM subscription coverage.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft plans a choice of RBAC instead of EDM_DataUploaders membership to authorise EDM uploads.
claims.quote: Customers will be able to choose to leverage RBAC to authorize users for uploading data to the Exact Data Match (EDM) service instead of leveraging the EDM_DataUploaders security group for authorization.
